item.title: First Day After Quitting: I Found a Beetle Family in the Park
item.description: On my first day after quitting, I started morning exercises and unexpectedly discovered a family of Chrysolina aurichalcea - beautiful metallic blue beetles. They seemed like a complete family, and I decided to document their daily lives every day.
